correctness.rationale: Under established theorem that total mutual-visibility in a Hamming graph is equivalent to choosing no pair at distance two, each layer of Q3 x Kn contains at most one even and one odd 3-bit word. For occupied layer sets A,B, the off-diagonal constraint graph D(A,B) between parity labels enforces odd label=complement(even); each connected component has exactly 4 choices. For A,B nonempty the only disconnected patterns are coincident singleton, singleton contained in opposite support, and coincident doubletons, each with exactly 2 components. Baseline connected contribution plus 12 per disconnected case gives the full stated polynomial. For n>=3 its high-degree coefficients k>=n+2 are 4*C(2n,k), exactly the four disjoint antipodal cylinders, giving rigidity and 4 maxima; for n=2 extra 12 yield 16. Independent direct distance-two subset enumeration for n=2,3,4 recovered all coefficients. The infinite n claim follows from graph-component classification, not from these finite samples.
